title: Animus behavior document
description: A JSON behavior under behaviors/<namespace>/<path>.json or packs/<pack>/behaviors/<namespace>/<path>.json. The plugin's compiler is authoritative.

revision.description: Raise this whenever the file changes. Changed bytes need a revision above the last accepted one.

entry.description: The routine a run starts with unless a trigger names another.

identifier.description: 1-64 lowercase letters, digits, _ or -, starting with a letter or digit.

module-capability.description: A capability of a Java module. Its arguments are checked when that module is installed.

anyOf.description: Advances a quest stage, by one unless by says otherwise, without passing maximum.

Starts, pauses, resumes, cancels or undoes the NPC's build. A start names a schematic in the schematics folder, or uses the NPC's saved builder section; it builds at x, y, z or where the NPC stands. Protection still applies.
Presents clickable options to the triggering player and publishes the validated click.

Engages or disengages the NPC's combat, attacks or releases a target, or guards a participant (no target stops guarding; player is the triggering player). Needs enabled combat settings; protection still applies.
Runs a console or player command; {player} becomes the triggering player's UUID. Allowed only for behaviors on the TOML allow-list, and never in a preview.
Turns the NPC toward a position or the triggering player.
Starts a route to a position in the NPC's world, or follows a reusable route. Completes when requested, or on arrival with wait.
Opens a chest GUI (kind inventory, the default), holographic menu, shop or, with Gloss installed, a Gloss menu for the triggering player.
Opens a shop for the triggering player.
Plays an animation of the NPC's rig on a layer (0-3). Higher layers blend over lower ones. Fires animation_finished when a once or hold clip reaches its end.
Plays a sound at the NPC for the triggering player or nearby players.
Sends dialogue text to the triggering player or to nearby players.
Changes the NPC's displayed name or skin until the runtime restarts or its definition changes.
Shows an item in an equipment slot, or clears the slot when no item is given. Lasts until the runtime restarts or the definition changes.
Sets a flag, true unless value says otherwise.
Sets a quest stage.
Shows a particle effect at the NPC to the triggering player or nearby players.
Stops one animation layer, or every played layer, and returns to the rig's idle animation.
Stops the NPC's current route and any route it is following.
Compares a flag. An unset flag is false.
True when the triggering player holds a permission. False when there is no triggering player.
Compares the NPC's spawned state and current health.
True when the triggering player, or any player with anyPlayer, is within the radius.
Compares a quest stage. An unset quest is stage zero.

type.description: The value type. There is no coercion.

initial.description: The value until something writes it, of the declared type.

scope.description: Who shares the value: one run (execution, the default), one NPC, one player, one NPC and player pair, or everyone.

lifetime.description: Required for every scope except execution: transient values last until the server stops, persistent values are stored.

bindings.description: Fills null placeholders in arguments from declared variables, keyed by JSON Pointer.

node-action.description: Runs a capability and waits for its result.

node-condition.description: Tests a capability, then runs then or else.

arguments.description: The capability's arguments.

then.description: Runs when the condition is true.

else.description: Runs when the condition is false.

arguments.description: Compares a flag. An unset flag is false.

node-wait.description: Waits a number of behavior ticks.

node-repeat.description: Runs its body a fixed number of times.

count.description: How many times the body runs.

node-parallel.description: Runs independent branches, then joins them.

node-call.description: Runs another routine of this document.

value.description: A literal of the variable's type, or {"variable": "name"} of the same type.

trigger.description: An automatic start for NPCs that list this behavior.

routine.description: Starts this routine instead of entry.

cooldownTicks.description: Overrides the configured cooldown, per trigger on each NPC.

dialogue.description: The id of an animus:choices prompt.
